# motherduck_version (Data Source)

Reads the MotherDuck version for the current SQL session.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "motherduck_version" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `value` (String) Scalar value returned by the MotherDuck SQL data source.
